prompt: Create an original 180 second acoustic minimalism instrumental composition for rest, unwinding and breathing exercises. Mood: peaceful, soft, spacious. Instruments: marimba, piano, muted strings. Style: phase-shifted repeating figures with small harmonic changes. Tempo approximately 92 BPM; F major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use a restrained arrangement, soft attacks, no sudden accents. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A melancholic and reflective orchestral piece, starting with a solo piano and evolving into a full string and woodwind arrangement. It features a slow, deliberate tempo with a sense of longing and introspection, building in emotional intensity.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而沉思的管弦乐曲，以独奏钢琴开场，逐渐发展成完整的弦乐和木管乐编排。它以缓慢而深思熟虑的速度，带着一种渴望和内省的感觉，情感强度逐渐增强。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
